title: Rite content, 2026-10 weeks 1–2 (19 Oct – 1 Nov 2026)
notes: Calendar: `docs/launch-kit-v2.md` (i), weeks 1 and 2. Rendered from `content/` against a local `wrangler dev --local` (no live-site rows). Card data built with `TODAY=2026-10-19`; every date on screen checked by `bun clips/check-cohorts.ts` (cohort clips + card facts sweep).

Regenerate (from `content/`, one command): `TODAY=2026-10-19 bun scripts/render-batch.ts --plan scripts/plan-2026-10-weeks-1-2.json --dest 2026-10-weeks-1-2-v2` (date check incl. each clip on its posting day → dial clips → cards → this folder → `content/out/2026-10-weeks-1-2-v2.zip`). With voiceover once `/admin/tts` is deployed: prefix `RITE_ADMIN_KEY=…`.

**Domain flag:** every asset and caption says **rite.report** (the kit's CTA and the intended launch domain), but rite.report is **not live yet**; the site is at rite.mickreal.workers.dev. Don't post until the domain resolves, or swap the captions' link for the workers.dev URL (the burned-in text can't be swapped without a re-render: `SITE=… bun remotion/scripts/build-data.ts` for cards; clips need the `lines` in `clips/cohorts.json` edited).

**v2 (smooth):** dial clips are rendered frame by frame at a constant 30 fps on a virtual clock (no screen recording), with eased crossfades between screens, captions that fade and rise in, human-paced typing and every date held ≥1.5 s; card verticals have an eased push-in and fades. 22–28 s per dial clip (kit: 20–40 s).

**Voiceover:** none in this export: the VO step (`content/clips/vo.ts`, the site's `POST /admin/tts`) needs `RITE_ADMIN_KEY` and the deployed endpoint, so every reel is silent with burned-in captions (a silent AAC track is included for schedulers). After deploy, re-run the command above with the key: clips with a kit script (1, 2, 3, 5 here) also get a `_vo` file timed to the spoken lines (loudness −16 LUFS), and `manifest.csv` then lists the `_vo` file with the silent one in `other_version`. No music, ever: add it in the app's reel editor.

**Style 3 (Anna, AI presenter):** Thu 22 Script 6 and Tue 27 its re-cut are rendered; Mon 26 Script 7 and Fri 30 the closest-turn piece are Anna-light presenter reels whose takes need ElevenLabs credits, so they post as interim versions (no Anna, no voice) until `npm run presenter:prep -- <id>` has made them. Sat 31 the "one line to carry" quote card needs a real reader's line with permission (none in hand): its fallback card goes out unless the original is ready. Sat 24 Lisa (style 5 green-screen) needs a creator: the backdrop screenshot and a captioned dial clip of her dates are provided as a stand-in.

**Time-sensitive captions:** Tue 20 clip now says "Today: 9° Aries" (the site shows 9° from 21 Oct to 2 Nov; it was re-rendered for the 26 Oct launch, so on this calendar's own 20 Oct it would be a degree off). Sat 24 Lisa clip (rewritten 17 Oct) says two of her passes are behind her and names 25 Jan 2027 as her last: post it between 25 Oct 2026 and 24 Jan 2027. Cards say "open now" (true until 12 Apr 2028).
Text-only posts (X / Threads, Reddit) are listed with no file; their copy is the kit's, verbatim. Reddit bodies are long: copy them from the kit (f) and read each subreddit's rules that day.

**Fallbacks and interim reels.** A post that depends on someone else (a reader's quote, a creator's repost) keeps its intent in `note` and stays a hand-made, manual post (`auto: false`). Its `fallback` is a ready video in Rite's own voice that is exported and uploaded as a post of its own the same day (slot "Fallback: …", `fallback_for` in the manifests) and goes out automatically, so the slot is never empty. Choosing: if the original is in hand before that week's Thursday render, set `"use": "original"` on the post (the fallback is dropped from the render, export and upload) and post the original by hand; if it arrives after the week is uploaded, post it by hand and cancel that day's fallback in the queue; `"use": "both"` posts both. Talking-head slots (`asset` = an Anna presenter reel) carry `interim`: until the reel is rendered (needs ElevenLabs credits: `npm run presenter:prep -- <id>`), the export uses the interim version (same cut, no Anna, no voice, music only; `interim: true` in the manifests), and the finished reel replaces it on the next export. See content/scripts/plan-posts.ts.
